name: otel-logs-ppl
description: Runs 39 PPL queries against an OTel logs index. Search-only.

name: otel-logs-ppl-test
description: Lightweight smoke test — single iteration of each query for validation.

name: otel-logs-random-mix
description: Sustained random PPL query mix at a TPS target. Each request picks one of the 39 PPL queries uniformly at random. Use for chaos testing or steady-state load.

name: otel-logs-ingest
description: Ingest only: delete/create index, bulk-index the frozen OTel corpus, flush. No queries. Mirrors clickbench datafusion-ingest; pass index_body=index.json for a plain Lucene index (default index-datafusion.json is the Mustang composite index).

name: dsl-otel-logs
description: Queries only: the 39 OTel queries as native OpenSearch DSL (/_search) for a vanilla Lucene index. Each is the idiomatic DSL of the matching PPL op, verified result-equivalent to PPL on OpenSearch 3.8.0 (MustangBenchmarkConfigResults scripts/nightly-perf/otel_dsl.py).
